title: Estrogenic and androgenic activity of tert-butyl phenolic antioxidants assessed by in vitro receptor transcriptional activation and their association with insilico molecular docking analysis.
one_liner_zh: 该文用转录激活实验和CB-Dock2分子对接评估叔丁基酚类抗氧化剂的雌激素/雄激素活性，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子-核受体，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Tert-butyl phenolic antioxidants (TBP-AOs) are utilized in a variety of consumer products, including food packaging, daily use items, and industrial applications. Their widespread use raises significant concerns regarding potential health risks, particularly endocrine disruption. However, our understanding of many TBP-AOs concerning endocrine systems remains limited, underscoring the need for screening of their hormonal activities and better insight into their adverse outcome pathways (AOPs). Transcriptional activation (TA) assays are crucial experimental tools in the early stages of risk assessment. This study evaluated the estrogenic and androgenic characteristics of 30 TBP-AOs through TA assays in hERalpha-HeLa-9903 and 22Rv1/MMTV_GR-KO cell lines, respectively, augmented by docking simulation using CB-Dock2. Our findings identified 21 estrogen receptor (ER) agonists, one ER antagonist, and eight androgen receptor (AR) antagonists, with significant correlations between biological activity and docking scores for specific proteins: 1GWR_C4 and 7KBS_C2 for ERalpha, and 2AM9_C1 for AR. These results enhance our understanding of TBP-AOs' toxicity on the endocrine system and confirm that TA assays and docking are effective methods for evaluating their endocrine activities. This research lays the foundation for future studies on endocrine disruptors, aiming to elucidate the mechanisms underlying molecular initiating events and key events within AOPs for TBP-AOs and other chemicals.
abstract_zh: 叔丁基酚类抗氧化剂（TBP-AOs）被广泛应用于各类消费品中，包括食品包装、日常用品及工业应用。其广泛使用引发了对潜在健康风险的重大关切，尤其是内分泌干扰效应。然而，我们对许多TBP-AOs在内分泌系统方面的影响了解仍有限，这凸显了对其激素活性进行筛查以及更深入理解其不良结局通路（AOPs）的必要性。转录激活（TA）试验是风险评估早期阶段的关键实验工具。本研究通过hERalpha-HeLa-9903和22Rv1/MMTV_GR-KO细胞系中的TA试验，分别评估了30种TBP-AOs的雌激素和雄激素特性，并辅以CB-Dock2进行对接模拟。我们的研究结果识别出21种雌激素受体（ER）激动剂、1种ER拮抗剂和8种雄激素受体（AR）拮抗剂，且生物活性与特定蛋白的对接得分之间存在显著相关性：ERalpha对应1GWR_C4和7KBS_C2，AR对应2AM9_C1。这些结果增进了我们对TBP-AOs在内分泌系统毒性方面的理解，并确认TA试验和对接模拟是评估其内分泌活性的有效方法。本研究为未来关于内分泌干扰物的研究奠定了基础，旨在阐明TBP-AOs及其他化学物质在AOPs中分子起始事件和关键事件的机制。
